claims.statement: The save action produced no visible success or failure feedback.
Keyboard focus order was not exercised in this run.

evidence.summary: The form remains unchanged after Save is selected.

findings.title: Save action has no observable result
findings.userImpact: A user cannot tell whether the setting is stored and may repeat or abandon the task.
findings.rootCause: The form submission state is not rendered next to the control that initiated the save.

recommendation.location: Business settings > Save action and inline status region
recommendation.recommendedChange: Render a persistent inline Saved checkmark or a specific error beside the Save control after the request completes.
recommendation.alternative: Show a page-level confirmation banner and move focus to it after submission.
recommendation.tradeoffs: Inline feedback has stronger action association; a banner is easier to reuse but can be missed on long pages.

findings.retest: Save once successfully and once with an injected failure; confirm the exact result and next action remain visible beside the control.

limitations: Only the synthetic save journey was exercised.
